calphad.phase_set: ALL eligible phases of the pruned system TDB (same set as databases/mc_fe_v2.062.tdb)

sweep.refine: +-5 K at 1.0 K around each detected transition

transition_definitions.T_first_liquid_C: smallest T with NP_LIQUID > 0.0001 (start of melting; published T_S/T_P)
transition_definitions.T_last_solid_C: largest T with any solid > 0.0001 (liquidus; published T_L)
transition_definitions.T_first_liquid_sustained_C: smallest T after which NP_LIQUID > 0.0001 at every higher T (noise-robust onset of melting)
transition_definitions.T_first_liquid_plus_BCC_A2_C: smallest T with both liquid and delta ferrite above 0.0001 (peritectic-like melting)

threshold_sensitivity.note: the surrogate never predicts exactly zero, so its first-liquid/last-solid crossing depends on the detection threshold; scanning thresholds separates tail effects from real curve offsets
threshold_sensitivity.truncation: the surrogate liquid curve is set to zero below its sustained first-liquid crossing so the scan is not dominated by isolated ~1e-4 low-T patches

fraction_deviation_notes.max_abs_dNP_outside_melting_region: max |NP_sur - NP_cal| over points outside [T_first_liquid - 15 K, T_last_solid + 15 K]
fraction_deviation_notes.phase_set_attribution: the point of max deviation is re-evaluated with the probe-active phase set (the surrogate's training phase set): if both phase sets give the same equilibrium, the deviation is model error, not a reference-side phase-set effect
